name: Write SETUP.md guide
prompt: Write SETUP.md in this repository: a short setup guide for the hello.py CLI project with an install step (pip install) and a run step (python hello.py --name ...). The verification script checks that SETUP.md contains 'pip install' and 'python'.
test_command: import pathlib; t=pathlib.Path('SETUP.md').read_text(encoding='utf-8'); assert 'pip install' in t and 'python' in t, 'SETUP.md must include install and run instructions'
